title: Nepal's Gandaki province, bordering Bihar allows cultivation of medical marijuana - WION
description: Nepal's Gandaki province, bordering Bihar allows cultivation of medical marijuana  WION
publisher.title: WION
full_article:
Cultivation of marijuana has always been illegal in Nepal but a controversial bill allowing the cultivation and medical use of cannabis, was endorsed by the chief of Nepal's Gandaki province, which shares its borders with neighbouring Bihar's West Champaran district at Valmikinagar, a tiger reserve area.

The bill was unanimously passed by province assembly members from the ruling coalition and opposition parties, reported Associated Press.

Gandaki is one of Nepal's seven provinces which is home to some of the country's most popular mountains and hiking trails, as well as the resort city of Pokhara.

full_article:
Several political, diplomatic and security developments were reported across South Asia and beyond on Sunday, with Bangladesh, Nepal and Pakistan-occupied Kashmir in focus, while China issued its highest typhoon warning, a murder arrest was made in Canada, and Yemen's Houthis claimed an attack in Saudi Arabia.

The updates included a suggestion from India's envoy in Dhaka that a meeting between Bangladesh Prime Minister Tarique Rahman and Prime Minister Narendra Modi could ease strains in ties, planned meetings by Nepal Prime Minister Balendra Shah 'Balen' with the Indian and Chinese ambassadors, and a new eight-party alliance in Nepal called the 'Progressive Front'.

In Dhaka, Indian High Commissioner Dinesh Trivedi said a meeting between Rahman and Modi could help resolve problems in bilateral relations between Bangladesh and India.

In Pakistan-occupied Kashmir, the PML(N) of Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif and his brother Nawaz appeared to be on the back foot as it prepared to take charge of the so-called government in the region. The party described the protesters there as "patriots" after months of violence.

description: India rejects Nepal’s objection to Kailash Mansarovar Yatra through Lipulekh pass, calls it unjustified  newsonair.gov.in
publisher.title: newsonair.gov.in
full_article:
India has rejected Nepal’s claim over Lipulekh Pass, termed it as a long-standing route for the Kailash Manasarovar Yatra since 1954 and the Yatra through this route has been going on for decades. Ministry of External Affairs spokesperson Randhir Jaiswal in a social media post said this in response to claims related to border issues made by Foreign Ministry of Nepal in the context of the annual Kailash Manasarovar Yatra.

He stressed that India’s position in this regard had been consistent and clear and this is not a new development. Mr Jaiswal pointed out that India has consistently maintained that such claims are neither justified nor based on historical facts and evidence. He stressed that such unilateral artificial enlargement of territorial claims is untenable. The spokesperson added that India remains open to a constructive interaction with Nepal on all issues in the bilateral relationship, including on resolving agreed outstanding boundary issues through dialogue and diplomacy.
translated:
भारत न॑ लिपुलेख दर्रा प॑ नेपाल केरऽ दावा क॑ खारिज करी क॑ एकरा १९५४ स॑ कैलाश मनसरोवर यात्रा लेली एगो लंबा समय स॑ चलै वाला मार्ग बतैलकै आरू ई मार्ग स॑ यात्रा दशकों स॑ चलै छै । विदेश मन्त्रालयके प्रवक्ता रणधीर जायसवाल नेपालके विदेश मन्त्रालयद्वारा वार्षिक कैलाश मनसरोवर यात्राके सन्दर्भमे सीमा मुद्दासे सम्बन्धित दावाके प्रतिक्रियामे सोशल मिडिया पोस्टमे ई बात बतौलनि ।

हुनी जोर देलकै कि ई मामला मँ भारत केरौ स्थिति सुसंगत आरू स्पष्ट रहलौ छै आरू ई कोनो नया घटना नै छै । श्री जयसवाल न॑ ई बात के ओर इशारा करलकै कि भारत लगातार ई बात के कहना छै कि ऐसनऽ दावा नै त॑ जायज छै आरू नै ही ऐतिहासिक तथ्य आरू सबूतऽ प॑ आधारित छै । हुनी ई बात प॑ जोर देलकै कि क्षेत्रीय दावा केरऽ ऐसनऽ एकतरफा कृत्रिम विस्तार असहनीय छै । प्रवक्ता नँ आरू कहलकै कि बातचीत आरू कूटनीति के माध्यम स॑ सहमत बकाया सीमा मुद्दा के समाधान सहित द्विपक्षीय संबंध के सब मुद्दा प॑ नेपाल के साथ रचनात्मक बातचीत लेली भारत खुललऽ छै ।

title: Nepal puts Tibetan refugee population at over 3,500 - Tibetan Review
description: Nepal puts Tibetan refugee population at over 3,500  Tibetan Review
publisher.title: Tibetan Review
full_article:
(TibetanReview.net, Aug09’26) – The police in Nepal have put the number of Tibetan refugees living in the country at over 3,500, the second largest group after Bhutanese refugees, with the total being over 10,000, reported myrepublica.nagariknetwork.com Aug 7. The report said the police made the figures public after misleading comments and discussions about refugees began circulating on social media.

The report cited police spokesperson Abi Narayan Kafle as saying 6,272 Bhutanese refugees were currently living in Nepal.

Kafle has put the number of Tibetan refugees living in the country, per police data, at 3,527, followed by 527 Rohingya refugees.

The vast majority of Tibetan refugees living in the country remain unregistered and therefore uncounted. Nepal stopped registering Tibetan refugees decades ago due to pressure from China which insists they are illegal migrants.

The refugees from Bhutan are ethnically Nepali (known as Lhotshampas) and the vast majority of their original total of over 1,00,000 – expelled between 1988 and 1993 – have been resettled in the West, starting in 2007. They were mostly taken in by the United States (85,000 individuals). The other counties included Australia, Canada, United Kingdom, New Zealand, Denmark, and The Netherlands.

The Himalayan kingdom threw them out as illegal migrants and, reportedly, in a political crackdown.

(TibetanReview.net, Aug09’26) – नेपाल केरऽ पुलिस न॑ देश म॑ रह॑ वाला तिब्बती शरणार्थी के संख्या ३,५०० स॑ भी अधिक बतैलकै, जे कि भूटानी शरणार्थी के बाद दोसरऽ सबसें बड़ऽ समूह छै, जेकरऽ कुल संख्या १०,००० स॑ भी अधिक छै, myrepublica.nagariknetwork.com न॑ ७ अगस्त क॑ रिपोर्ट करलकै सोशल मीडिया पर शरणार्थी घुमब शुरू भ गेल।

रिपोर्ट मे पुलिस प्रवक्ता अबी नारायण काफ्ले के हवाला स कहल गेल अछि जे एखन नेपाल मे 6272 भूटानी शरणार्थी रहैत अछि।

काफ्ले न॑ पुलिस केरऽ आंकड़ा के अनुसार देश म॑ रह॑ वाला तिब्बती शरणार्थी के संख्या ३,५२७ बतैलकै, जेकरा बाद ५२७ रोहिंग्या शरणार्थी छै ।

देश म॑ रह॑ वाला तिब्बती शरणार्थी केरऽ विशाल बहुमत अपंजीकृत छै आरू ई लेली ओकरऽ गिनती नै छै । चीन के दबाव के कारण नेपाल दशकों पहिने तिब्बती शरणार्थी के पंजीकरण बंद क देलक जे ओ अवैध प्रवासी के जिद्द पर अड़ल अछि।

भूटान स॑ आबै वाला शरणार्थी जातीय रूप स॑ नेपाली (लोतशम्पस के नाम स॑ जानलऽ जाय छै) छै आरू ओकरऽ मूल कुल १,००,००० स॑ भी अधिक के विशाल बहुमत – जेकरा १९८८ आरू १९९३ के बीच निष्कासित करलऽ गेलऽ छेलै – क॑ पश्चिम म॑ पुनर्वासित करी देलऽ गेलऽ छै, जे २००७ स॑ शुरू होय गेलऽ छै । अन्य काउंटी में ऑस्ट्रेलिया, कनाडा, यूनाइटेड किंगडम, न्यूजीलैंड, डेनमार्क, आ नीदरलैंड शामिल छल ।

हिमालय राज्य न॑ हुनका सब क॑ अवैध प्रवासी के रूप म॑ बाहर फेंकलकै आरू खबर छै कि राजनीतिक दमन म॑ भी ।
